stores.name: Unraid templates
stores.how_to: One template XML per image at the repository root; deprecated images are in deprecated/.

stores.name: CasaOS app store
stores.how_to: CasaOS > App Store > More apps > Add source.

stores.name: Umbrel community app store
stores.how_to: Umbrel > App Store > Community App Stores > add this repository URL.

stores.name: Runtipi app store
stores.how_to: Runtipi > Settings > App Stores > Add App Store > this repository URL.

stores.name: Cosmos Cloud market
stores.how_to: Cosmos > Market > Sources > add the URL.

stores.name: Arcane template registry
stores.how_to: Arcane > Customization > Templates > Add Registry > the URL.
